chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, Ibrahim ibn Hashim, and al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi narrated to us, from al-Husayn ibn Saif, from Umar ibn Shimir, from Jabir ibn Yazid al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

'There is nothing but that it has something equal to it, except for Allah, Mighty and Glorious, for there is nothing equal to Him. And 'La ilaha illa Allah' (There is no god but Allah), for there is nothing equal to it. And a tear from the fear of Allah, for there is no measure for it. If it flows upon his face, he will not be covered by dust or humiliation after it ever.'
ai.seo_question: What is the unique reward for a tear shed in fear of Allah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq, the Prophet (s.a.w.s.) establishes the unique incomparability of Allah and the declaration of Tawhid, contrasting them with all created things that possess equivalents. He further highlights the spiritual efficacy of a tear shed from khawf (fear of God), noting that it serves as a permanent shield against dunya's dust and adhab's humiliation, a concept deeply valued in Shia asceticism (zuhd).

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 6.  Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) says that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.) said:

There is nothing which is not equal in weight  to  something  else.  Except  for  Allah,  as  nothing  is equal  to  Him  and  nothing  is  equal  to  ‘There  is  no  god except Allah’ also. And there is no measure for tears that flow in fear of Allah. Even if a single tear flows on the face of  a  person,  he  or  she  would  never  be  helpless  and humiliated.
